title: AEAD failure returns InvalidState instead of dedicated error
description:
File: oscore/src/edhoc/initiator.rs:441, 445-446

Issue: AEAD cipher initialization (`AesCcm::new_from_slice`) and encryption (`encrypt_in_place_detached`) both map their errors to `EdhocError::InvalidState`. This is misleading since:
1. Cipher init failure is typically a key length issue (should be `KeyDerivation`)
2. Encryption failure in CCM indicates internal error (should be separate variant)

Impact: Debugging crypto failures becomes harder when multiple failure modes map to generic `InvalidState`.

Suggested fix: Use appropriate error variants:
```rust
let cipher = AesCcm::new_from_slice(&k_3)
    .map_err(|_| EdhocError::KeyDerivation)?;  // or BufferTooSmall
let tag = cipher.encrypt_in_place_detached(...)
    .map_err(|_| EdhocError::EncryptFailed)?;  // new variant
```
